claims.text: Profiles apply a few text rules after conversion; conversion itself is identical
Standard adds title if missing and a source note naming file, size and engine
Standard 98 words; Clean 90 words, 469 bytes, smallest; Compact 95; RAG-ready 118
Clean differed from Standard by exactly the source note on this file
Compact removes every blank line and every triple hyphen anywhere
Table separator became |  |  |; GFM delimiter row needs hyphens, so rows stop being a table
March---April became MarchApril; blank line in code removed; Compact kept the source note
Compact is also applied to ZIP results
claims.source: backendZ/app/archive_tasks.py write_outputs calls finalize_markdown with the job profile

claims.text: RAG-ready added a marker inside the code block before ## a comment; code fence content is literal text
No markers before H1 or ###; RAG-ready does not embed, index, retrieve or store
Token count shown is an estimate, not provider billing
To change profile after converting: remove, re-add, select profile, convert
